crossRefs.note: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?
Revive me, Yahweh, for your name’s sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.

translations.web: I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither have I rest; but trouble comes.”
translations.bsb: I am not at ease or quiet; I have no rest, for trouble has come.”
translations.kjv: I was not in safety, neither had I rest, neither was I quiet; yet trouble came.
translations.asv: I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither have I rest; But trouble cometh.
